params.name: input
params.description: Path to comma-separated file containing information about the samples in the experiment.

params.name: outdir
params.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

params.name: chr
params.description: Only use reads mapping to a specific chromosome/region. Has to be specified as in bam: i.e chr1, chr{1..22} (gets all reads mapping to chr1 to 22), 1, "X Y", incorrect naming will lead to a potentially silent error.

params.name: no_read_QC
params.description: If specified, no quality control will be performed on extracted reads. Useful, if this is done anyways in the subsequent workflow.

params.name: no_stats
params.description: If specified, skips all quality control and stats computation, including `FastQC` on both input bam and output reads, `samtools flagstat`, `samtools idxstats`, and `samtools stats`.

params.name: reads_in_memory
params.description: Reads to store in memory [default = '100000']. Only relevant for use with `--samtools_collate_fast`.

params.name: samtools_collate_fast
params.description: Uses fast mode for samtools collate in `sortExtractMapped`, `sortExtractUnmapped` and `sortExtractSingleEnd`.

params.name: genome
params.description: Name of iGenomes reference.

params.name: fasta
params.description: Path to FASTA genome file.

params.name: fasta_fai
params.description: Path to FASTA FAI genome index file.

params.name: igenomes_ignore
params.description: Do not load the iGenomes reference config.

params.name: igenomes_base
params.description: The base path to the igenomes reference files

params.name: custom_config_version
params.description: Git commit id for Institutional configs.

params.name: custom_config_base
params.description: Base directory for Institutional configs.

params.name: config_profile_name
params.description: Institutional config name.

params.name: config_profile_description
params.description: Institutional config description.

params.name: config_profile_contact
params.description: Institutional config contact information.

params.name: config_profile_url
params.description: Institutional config URL link.

params.name: version
params.description: Display version and exit.

params.name: publish_dir_mode
params.description: Method used to save pipeline results to output directory.

params.name: email
params.description: Email address for completion summary.

params.name: email_on_fail
params.description: Email address for completion summary, only when pipeline fails.

params.name: plaintext_email
params.description: Send plain-text email instead of HTML.

params.name: max_multiqc_email_size
params.description: File size limit when attaching MultiQC reports to summary emails.

params.name: monochrome_logs
params.description: Do not use coloured log outputs.

params.name: multiqc_title
params.description: MultiQC report title. Printed as page header, used for filename if not otherwise specified.

params.name: multiqc_config
params.description: Custom config file to supply to MultiQC.

params.name: multiqc_logo
params.description: Custom logo file to supply to MultiQC. File name must also be set in the MultiQC config file

params.name: multiqc_methods_description
params.description: Custom MultiQC yaml file containing HTML including a methods description.

params.name: validate_params
params.description: Boolean whether to validate parameters against the schema at runtime

params.name: pipelines_testdata_base_path
params.description: Base URL or local path to location of pipeline test dataset files

params.name: trace_report_suffix
params.description: Suffix to add to the trace report filename. Default is the date and time in the format yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss.

params.name: help
params.description: Display the help message.

params.name: help_full
params.description: Display the full detailed help message.

params.name: show_hidden
params.description: Display hidden parameters in the help message (only works when --help or --help_full are provided).

params.name: fasta
params.description: Path to FASTA genome file (dynamic: params.fasta = params.fasta ?: getGenomeAttribute('fasta') in main.nf; mandatory for CRAM input when --genome is not given).

params.name: fasta_fai
params.description: Path to FASTA FAI genome index file (dynamic: params.fasta_fai = params.fasta_fai ?: getGenomeAttribute('fasta_fai') in main.nf).

columns.name: sample_id

FastQC gives general quality metrics about your reads.

warnings: FASTQC_PRE_CONVERSION.out.zip/html are emitted by PRE_CONVERSION_QC but BAMTOFASTQ does not pass them into MULTIQC's ch_multiqc_files (the mixing line is commented out in workflows/bamtofastq.nf); pre-conversion FastQC outputs are published but not aggregated.
conf/modules.config declares a global default publishDir with a dynamic path expression; recorded as selector 'process (global default)' for processes without a withName publishDir.
The anonymous workflow {} entrypoint in main.nf has no declared name; recorded as subworkflow MAIN_ENTRYPOINT (kind: utility).
test param no_read_qc is written 'no_read_QC' in nextflow.config but 'no_read_qc' in tests/no_qc.nf.test and nextflow_schema.json uses no_read_QC; case differs between sources.

Snapshot .parsed_content omitted from candidates: snap files are large; captures/helpers/ignore lists carry the assertion structure, and md5 expectations for the selected candidate are listed in outputs of the test plan phase instead.
PREPARE_INDICES.out.ch_fasta_fai uses .first() after mixing; multi-FASTA scenarios are not exercised by any test.
